scope: One matched diagnostic replay of each original failed noise and slip scenario. No new actuation, no benchmark replacement.
dry_rule: Test each original target at the single named checkpoint. Keep native FK, original limit array and margins, 30 iterations and original convergence tolerances. Contrast 1 shifts only initial shaft yaw 1 deg toward zero without crossing it. Contrast 2 starts from original seed and halves only the axis terms' optimisation weight; acceptance thresholds are unchanged. Do not execute, advance, close, or feed any candidate into control. Verify state and simulation time unchanged; verify original replay control events, constraints and frame hashes before interpreting. Success is an IK/FK candidate, not acceptance of interpolation, wrist collision or a reachable live motion.
optical_rule: Only on slip, snapshot exact estimator inputs and mutable prior state at ticks 29 to 32. Match RGB-D to archived fault frames and original validity, reason, progress, and slit support. Then count original ahead-window seen, foreground, sheet and occupied-gap checks in offline replay; distinguish direct pre-cut candidate from auxiliary scans by call site. No positive label or action may be inferred from a rejected pixel/bin.
